Keep towels and robes within reach without cluttering your walls—this modern retractable wall hook pulls out when you need it and pushes back in when you don’t. Backed by a lifetime warranty, it’s a space-saving solution for crisp, clean modern bathroom hardware.

  • Hang with confidence: supports up to 15 lb for towels, robes, and coats
  • Match your existing look: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with a cabinet knob of your choice
  • Designed for everyday use: brass construction for enduring performance
  • Easy, straightforward install: mounts to standard interior walls with included toggle bolts and hardware
